81-Cell Paramasayika Grid (Centre 9 Gold Cells: Brahmasthana)

Sanctum Geometry

Brahmasthana (The Sacred Nucleus)

The central 9 cells of the 81-cell Paramasayika Mandala. In Vedic temple architecture, this zone remains completely unweighted by heavy superstructures, channeling cosmic prana directly to the deity's Garbhagriha.

Rule of the Sthapati

"The proportion of every pillar, beam, corniche, and finial is mathematically tethered to the width of the sanctum (Garbhagriha module)."

From Quarry to Consecration

One House · Seven Stages · No Handoffs

Engineering, stone procurement, hand-carving, trial dry-fit, and Pan-India installation under one single master contract.

01

Site & Mandala

वास्तु

True cardinal survey, soil bearing calculations, and the Vastupurusha grid struck on the ground.

02

Shastra Drawing

रेखा

Full elevation, section, and Agama iconography blueprints issued as buildable stone manifests.

03

Cost Estimation

व्यय

Transparent itemized stone volume, carving complexity, freight, and crane erection costing.

04

Stone Sourcing

शिला

Bansi Paharpur, Jaisalmer sandstone, Makrana marble, and monolithic granites tested and blocked.

05

Karkhana Carving

शिल्प

Hand-sculpted by generational Karigars with continuous inspection by our chief Sthapati.

06

Dry-Fit & Crating

योजना

Shrine trial-assembled at our yard, every stone numbered, and transported to your state.

07

Pratishtha Rites

प्रतिष्ठा

Our craftsmen raise the temple on site and stay through the final consecration rites.
